text: ＊は　ひでんわざ　なみのりを　つかい　なみに　のりまくった！

structure.jp: ひでんわざ　なみのりを　つかい
structure.en: used the HM move Surf, and

structure.jp: なみに　のりまくった！

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto a verb says you do it over and over with wild energy. のりまくった = 'rode like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The verb is cut short (つかい instead of つかって) to join it to what comes next, like 'and'; this is the written-style version of the て link. なみのりを　つかい = 'used Surf and...'.
